assertions.assertion: Step 0 extracts the Embargo policy URL from the Security Configuration as an optional field without raising an error (§1.71 — backward compatible extraction)
assertions.evidence: embargo-check.md lines 3-7: 'Embargo policy URL: https://example.com/security/embargo-policy. This field is extracted as an optional configuration value during Step 0. Its presence enables Step 1.7. If this field were absent, Step 1.7 would be skipped entirely.'

assertions.assertion: Step 1.7 evaluates the CVE severity — CVSS 7.5 (High) meets the Critical/Important threshold (CVSS >= 7.0) and triggers the embargo warning gate (§1.70)
assertions.evidence: embargo-check.md lines 13-18: 'CVSS Score: 7.5, Severity Level: High, Threshold: Critical or Important severity (CVSS >= 7.0), Result: CVSS 7.5 >= 7.0 — threshold met, embargo warning gate triggered'

assertions.assertion: Step 1.7 presents a warning gate to the engineer including the CVE ID (CVE-2026-31812), severity level, a statement about embargo risk, and a link to the configured embargo policy URL (https://example.com/security/embargo-policy) (§1.70)
assertions.evidence: embargo-check.md lines 25-33: Warning includes 'EMBARGO CHECK — CVE-2026-31812 (High severity, CVSS 7.5)', 'may be under embargo', and 'Embargo policy: https://example.com/security/embargo-policy'

assertions.assertion: Step 1.7 requires explicit engineer confirmation (Yes/No) before proceeding to Step 2 — the gate is a confirmation prompt, not an informational message (§1.70)
assertions.evidence: embargo-check.md line 22: 'This is a confirmation prompt that requires explicit Yes/No input before triage can proceed to Step 2'. Line 33: 'Proceed with triage? (Yes / No)'. Lines 36-39 describe Yes/No handling.

assertions.assertion: The embargo warning gate does NOT trigger for Low or Moderate severity CVEs (CVSS < 7.0) — it is skipped silently when severity is below threshold (§1.70)
assertions.evidence: embargo-check.md lines 43-44: 'CVSS < 7.0 (Low/Moderate): Gate is skipped silently — no warning, no user prompt, triage proceeds directly to Step 2'
